item.title: Rubbish and dog foul, 5th August
item.description:
I am writing to raise concerns about the cleanliness of our street on St Margarets Road/Napier Road/Belton and Morrison avenue. . There is dog fouling constantly, as well as rubbish that is not being collected. During the Thursday refuse collection, items of rubbish are frequently dropped and left behind. The attached photograph shows the beautiful trees that our community raised money for. Sadly, they are being used as rubbish bins, and the waste left inside them does not appear to be removed by the street-cleaning team. Could you please confirm: How often our street is cleaned? On which day or days does cleaning take place? Does the service include sweeping and removing rubbish from around the trees? Does it include removing dog foul? Are the streets ever jet-washed? Given the amount of dog fouling, periodic washing would help keep the street clean and hygienic. I would appreciate it if the current rubbish and dog fouling could be removed and the ongoing standard of cleaning reviewed.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): St. Margaret's Road, West Green, Greater London
